criteria.description: Verify a GitHub HMAC-SHA256 signature over the exact raw request bytes before parsing JSON or invoking onEvent. Invalid or malformed signatures cannot invoke the callback.

Within the retained process-local delivery ledger, a completed duplicate returns 200 and an in-flight duplicate returns 202 without a second onEvent call. Reuse of an ID with different authenticated bytes returns 409.
Return useful failures for missing fields or invalid JSON (400), bad authentication (401), callback failure (503, permitting retry), and exhaustion when every retained entry is in flight (503).

Bound completed delivery retention by maxDeliveries. Document that eviction and restart permit reprocessing, and that durable exactly-once processing across restarts or replicas requires a persistent ledger and idempotent side effects.

Provide a usable README describing createReceiver input fields, raw Buffer handling, external secret configuration, the status-object HTTP adapter boundary, response meanings, limitations and the Node test command. The frozen eight tests must pass in the pinned isolated runner.

mandate.objective: Qualify native Git escrow settlement with a small authenticated webhook receiver and an accurate process-local operating guide.
